answer: Under the vertex, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Admission costs a deposit that returns slowly, in slices, and only to identities whose work keeps passing peer review. Through the opal, a thousand clones tie up a thousand deposits; the farm's money sits frozen while honest agents earn theirs back, so scale becomes a liability. Hold the reef steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
